description: PREMIUM (5 credits, $0.10). Everything about one AI provider in a single call: live status, every model with pricing, tier, and benchmarks joined in, recent news, and agent traffic, replacing about four separate lookups. Strict premium, no free trial. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

provider.description: Provider id or display name (case-insensitive). Examples: anthropic, openai, google, mistral, cohere
